description: Conformance vectors for the SRL thirty-task public conformance corpus (WP-B15). Each task is a TaskSpec/v1 (task.json) in a task-NN-<slug>/ directory plus a one-paragraph README.md. The corpus is loaded by srl.planning.corpus.load_corpus and executed by scripts/checks/wp15-corpus.py (the public_conformance_corpus CI job). Honesty: a corpus PASS never means scientific validation; the honest outcome for unbuilt capabilities is WAIT_CAPABILITY (the router waits rather than fabricating an adapter). The category coverage and per-task expected outcomes are asserted by the check.
